import SystemE
import Book1.Prop34.Main
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

set_option systemE.solverTime 30 in
theorem helper_1_36_step2_assumption2 (e f g h : Point) (AH BG EF HG : Line)
    (heAH : e.onLine AH) (hhAH : h.onLine AH)
    (hfBG : f.onLine BG) (hgBG : g.onLine BG)
    (heEF : e.onLine EF) (hfEF : f.onLine EF)
    (hhHG : h.onLine HG) (hgHG : g.onLine HG) (hhg : h ≠ g)
    (hss : e.sameSide f HG)
    (hpar : ¬AH.intersectsLine BG) (hpar2 : ¬EF.intersectsLine HG) :
    |(f─g)| = |(e─h)| := by
  euclid_apply (line_from_points h f) as HF
  euclid_apply (proposition_34 e h f g AH BG EF HG HF)
  euclid_finish

end Elements.Book1
